title: Vallee urges Hynek to review Blue Book's 'psychological' cases
place_text: Wright-Patterson Air Force Base, Dayton, Ohio

tellings.quote: jacqu valet had just met with Dr at rright patteron Air Force Base in Dayton Ohio in 1964

plain: A documentary filmmaker, James Fox, told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, about a 1964 meeting at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base in Dayton, Ohio. Fox says that a researcher named Jacques Vallee had just met there with Dr. J. Allen Hynek, a scientist who worked with Project Blue Book, the US Air Force's UFO study of the 1950s and 60s. According to Fox, Vallee pushed Hynek to look again at the Blue Book cases the Air Force had filed away as 'psychological', because some of those reports might deserve to be taken seriously.
